_doc: Trailer sound-design layer, anchored to the cue sheet (videos/music/cue_sheet.json named_hits / sections), not to frames, so it re-times itself if the sheet changes. 'at' is a fallback chain: hit:<name> | section:<name>[.end] with optional +Nb/-Nb (beats at the sheet's BPM) or +Nf (frames). 'until' crops/loops the asset. 'group' dedupes against EDL clip cues of the same group (the EDL wins). featured=true cues must clear the music by >= 6 LU. only_with: used only when the bed path contains that string (e.g. the original-score alternate). v2: the BEEP is the tuned beep_tuned_C5 (cue sheet beep_pitch); the payoff slam carries level_win_big (re-orchestrated, replaces any in-game level_win within 0.5 s); the song already has its reversed cymbal into f3026, the Twinkle score gets revcymbal_1bar from the score itself. Sound milestone (Critic): one section per device (heartbeat = cold open, ticking = build, reversed cymbal = 2 beats into f434 + Lights Out, braam once), shards via the EDL shatter (-10 dB, +3 f), song payoff = level_win_fpow (F power chords), public payoff = level_win_big (C major), room tone starts where the bed reaches digital zero.

cues._why: Critic fix 5: the title letters (sig_b phrase + the game's letter collapses) were the loudest moment of the first half
Critic fix 5: build stingers (gremlin flip / ghost phase / wobble) -3 dB, so the build climbs to the drop instead of topping it
Critic fix 5: no music ducking under the logo reveal; the drop is a co-hit
Director: the proof bed is submerged (-8.5 dB); the proof SFX carry the energy (peak ~ -14 LUFS short-term)
on the beat grid: 4 bars from the first downbeat (f50) into the collapse; cold open only
shard tail, -10 dB, 3 frames after the collapse transient (Critic sound #3); skipped if the EDL has its own shatter
moonlit night under the cold open: a continuous bed (8 dB under the music) so the trailer never opens on digital silence and the music-box gaps don't read as level jumps
ticking in the build only; the public score has its own wood-block clock there
braam once, at the build lift
Lights Out stays empty: only the last 2 beats, -6 dB lower
the song's payoff is F minor: power chords, no 3rd
final-chord sub tail: felt, not heard (a 5 s sub bed reads low on K-weighting, so it is set 12 dB under)
